snippet.title: It's Hard Being A Meatball
snippet.description:
A minute or two of my latest brain-spasm.
Made for #Meatlyjam.
Download here: http://antonhand.itch.io/its-hard-being-a-meatball

Windows Stand-alone only 
Xbox 360 controller required
Recent i5+mid-range gaming gpu or better recommended
Crashes a lot. 
Apparently Physx doesn't like ~1500 rigidbodies active at once...
